patch.value: Observed while importing a new GitHub report on the current 2026.10.11 checkout. A JSON external_ref fails before creation; source URL intake succeeds when retained in body. The recommended update --external-ref fails as declared_nowhere. Verify the intended SDK/CLI external-reference write contract and provide a reachable recovery; do not invent a flag, add a blanket field override, or weaken reserved-field guards.
Core external-reference refusal recommends a flag absent from the CLI lexicon

Current checkout create --stdin-json refuses an external_ref field as core_item_field_requires_dedicated_flag and recommends pm update <id> --external-ref <value>. Following that recovery fails because --external-ref is declared nowhere, including update. The refusal cannot supply its promised recovery.

Reproduce in an isolated initialized tracker with unchanged-byte refusal evidence; align external-reference mutation support with public SDK contracts; generated help/contracts and actual dispatch agree; a negative control detects ghost recovery flags; all reserved-field recovery recommendations use declared executable paths
Every reserved-core-field refusal names an executable supported write path or truthfully states that no CLI mutation path is available.
create --stdin-json advertises update --external-ref; following it exits 2 with a declared_nowhere unknown-option refusal.
